name: zawazawa-moderation-review
description: Investigate ZAWAZAWA reports with repository policies and review proposals in a single interactive approval list.

interface.shortDescription: Investigate reports and review proposals in one safe workflow.
interface.longDescription: Uses repository-specific policies to investigate ZAWAZAWA reports, then shows up to 100 proposals at once so an administrator can approve, hold, or approve a server-resolved structured alternative for each post. Snapshot-bound decisions and the append-only execution journal never change ZAWAZAWA by themselves.
defaultPrompt: Use $zawazawa-setup to set up ZAWAZAWA moderation interactively without editing configuration files.
Investigate unresolved ZAWAZAWA reports using this repository's moderation policies.
Show all investigated ZAWAZAWA reports in one review list.
Let me approve, hold, or revise each moderation proposal.
